scope: Native is_binary_1 and complete is_binary_fx/is_binary_fy cases, with the owned read-only bitstring metadata adapter.
adaptations: The exact is_binary/1 BIF charges one native step and returns true only for guest bitstrings whose bit length is divisible by eight, independent of starting bit offset. The owned adapter reads metadata without pinning or modifying volatile/writable storage, and never traverses payload bytes or allocates.

Project complete X/Y native guard cases, replacing only the native predicate expression with the owned read-only metadata predicate. Admit only the exact BIF and guards. Literal lowering overwrites x1023, so both verifier edges discard its previous shape facts; normalized proof tests cover that boundary.

Independent OTP and compiled fixtures cover empty/heap/reference binaries, partial bitstrings, unaligned byte-sized sub-binaries, body and X/Y guards, allocating continuations, literal guards and nonbinary classes including pid/reference/functions. Native tests check source metadata/refcount preservation for volatile and writable terms.

Reuse and extend the integer/list/atom predicate harness with binary cases, forced GC, allocator/work prefixes, denial at the allocation-free primitive boundary, output survival and final balance. Collection belongs to following allocation, not the binary predicate itself. Real shared-worker tests verify exact bytes and budgets, safe reuse, peer survival and reclamation.
